authority_limits.parallel_assignments: none unless the Hokage changes the order

records.return_condition: Hokage revocation, team dissolution, lawful reassignment, retirement, death, or incapacity

rule: Intact unit assignments retain source owner, home unit, standards and history. Raw personnel assignments retain source accounting/home claims and may remain unorganized until the receiving commander lawfully forms homogeneous units. Assignment changes authority, not ownership.
return_rule: Return intact units or surviving raw-personnel claims to the source home chain; preserve casualties, injuries, experience, morale/cohesion, lawful promotions, equipment loss and history; dissolve receiving-only formations/orders; then invoke source reconstitution.
